title: Spectral sparsity bounds for decision trees
statement: Let $T$ be a decision tree on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with real-valued leaves, and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ be the function it computes. The number of nonzero Fourier coefficients of $f$ is at most both $L(T)2^{d(T)}$ and $4^{d(T)}$, where $L(T)$ is the number of leaves and $d(T)$ is the depth of the tree.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree on the $n$-coordinate Boolean cube with real-valued leaves
